episodes.title: Aynadaki Yabanci
episodes.purpose: Hook the recognition premise and place the evidence in Akira's hands.
episodes.story: Patient Zero Elias cannot recognize his own reflection. Four days earlier, Akira accepts his sealed cold-chain case while MNEMOS marks the delivery as stolen.
episodes.turn: Akira hears Mina's voice at home but feels nothing when she sees her face.
episodes.game_hook: Cold-chain courier tutorial and first identity mismatch.

episodes.title: Sesini Taniyorum
episodes.purpose: Force Akira and Sera into conflict while proving voice is useful but not infallible.
episodes.story: Clinics fill with patients who recognize voices but not faces. Sera corners Akira, then misidentifies her own partner during a forged evacuation call.
episodes.turn: The case plays Elias's first recording: the outbreak was anticipated.
episodes.game_hook: Voice, gait and object-based identity checks.

episodes.title: Isim Yerine
episodes.purpose: Give Mina agency and establish a civilian alternative to biometric rule.
episodes.story: Identity theft and wrong-family transfers spread. Mina creates a three-part protocol using a shared memory, a behavior and a rotating physical token.
episodes.game_hook: Build and test trust chains; false positives have consequences.

episodes.title: Karantina Cizgisi
episodes.purpose: Close act one and reveal what Akira is carrying.
episodes.story: Varga seals the North Ring. Akira and Sera cross a collapsing checkpoint and discover that the case contains the human-trial ledger plus a treatment key, not a pathogen sample.
episodes.turn: Elias enters a coma before authenticating the final file.
episodes.game_hook: District closure changes routes and faction access.

episodes.title: Esik Protokolu
episodes.purpose: Define scarcity through Akira's irreversible moral choice.
episodes.story: Maelle demonstrates MAB-TJ, which may interrupt early neuroinvasion. One viable dose remains between infected Akira and a child whose symptoms began hours later.
episodes.turn: Akira gives away the dose and conceals her worsening spatial errors.
episodes.game_hook: Treatment allocation with no perfect outcome.

episodes.title: Kirmizi Hat
episodes.purpose: Turn Akira's signature competence into a liability.
episodes.story: A false broadcast diverts an evacuation train into a sealed tunnel. Akira leads survivors through a route she knew by heart while her internal map fractures.
episodes.turn: Sera realizes only an MNEMOS administrator could have authored the order.

episodes.title: Sessizlik Emri
episodes.purpose: Remove the city's strongest remaining human identity channel.
episodes.story: Citing voice cloning and panic, Varga suspends civilian radio. Mina's network becomes illegal while Sera uses her clearance to keep one transmitter alive.
episodes.turn: The government relocates unverified citizens to the Cold Archive district.
episodes.game_hook: Stealth radio relays and misinformation triage.

episodes.title: Sifir Derece
episodes.purpose: Move the disease into autonomic collapse and make the crisis personal for Mina.
episodes.story: Temperature regulation fails across overcrowded shelters during a power outage. Mina becomes infected while keeping the identity network online.
episodes.turn: Only ADEX-R may save her, at the risk of erasing autobiographical memory.
episodes.game_hook: Heat, power and medicine routing under a shared countdown.

episodes.title: Odunc Anilar
episodes.purpose: Complicate the apparent cure and divide the allies.
episodes.story: ADEX-R patients wake alive but with missing years and MNEMOS reconstructions presented as memories. Varga calls it recovery; Maelle calls it survival without consent.
episodes.turn: Mina enters treatment under a false state identity.
episodes.game_hook: Choose whether reconstructed records may stabilize patients.

episodes.title: Sekseninci Denek
episodes.purpose: Reveal the origin without reducing the season to one evil mastermind.
episodes.story: Elias's ledger proves FHD-80 was LIMEN variant eighty, designed to weaken traumatic facial associations. Maelle authorized the platform; Varga expanded testing after fatal warnings.
episodes.turn: Elias dies on day 17 and the last decryption key must be inferred from testimony.

episodes.title: Beni Hatirlama
episodes.purpose: Resolve the sisters' emotional arc before the institutional climax.
episodes.story: Mina survives ADEX-R but remembers neither Akira nor their childhood. Akira refuses to force a state-generated memory onto her and introduces herself through actions.
episodes.turn: Sera releases her access history, sacrificing immunity and opening a route into the Spire.
episodes.game_hook: Consent-based memory choices and final faction alignment.

episodes.title: Esik Seksen
episodes.purpose: Answer the theme while leaving the wider outbreak open for a game and later seasons.
episodes.story: Akira, Sera and Maelle enter MNEMOS as Varga prepares compulsory ADEX-R deployment. They broadcast the ledger, treatment risks and source code so districts can choose transparently.
episodes.turn: Mina cannot recognize Akira, but completes their childhood melody after Akira stops asking to be remembered.
episodes.game_hook: The anime fixes public disclosure; the game determines which districts survive to receive it.

season_end_state: MNEMOS survives as public infrastructure but loses unilateral authority.
MAB-TJ and ADEX-R become auditable treatments with explicit risks.
Akira is alive, infected and neurologically unstable.
Mina is alive but must rebuild her relationship with Akira.
Varga is detained, not killed, preserving future political conflict.
